text: Paper accepted at **ACM CHI 2026**: "Contextual Scaffolding and Self-Efficacy: Supporting Computer Skill Development among Blind Learners in India."
Two papers accepted at **ACM CHIIR 2026** in Seattle, WA.
"Understanding Online Discussion Experiences of Blind Screen Reader Users" accepted in the **IJHCI Journal**.
"Examining Inclusive Computing Education for Blind Students in India" accepted at **ACM SIGCSE TS 2026**.
Received the **Best Paper Award** at ACM Web for All (W4A) 2025.

"Insights in Adaptation: Examining Self-reflection Strategies of Job Seekers with Visual Impairments in India" accepted at **ACM CSCW 2025**.
Named **Dr. Hussein Abdel-Wahab Memorial Graduate Fellow** at Old Dominion University.
